test_title: PYST 40: SSC GD Constable - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 1st November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: Find the Simple interest on Rs. 2,400 from 20 March 2019 to 31 may 2019 at 6{1 over 4}% rate?
solution:
Given:

Principal = Rs. 2400

Rate of interest = 6{1 over 4}% = 6.25%

Concept used:

1 year = 365 days

Simple Interest, SI = (P × R × T)/100

Amount = P + SI

where

P = Principal amount

R = Rate of interest per year

T = Time in years

Calculation:

Days between 20 March 2019 to 31 may 2019 = 73 days

Now, the simple interest incurred on Rs. 2400 for 73 days

⇒ (2400 × 6.25 × 73/365)/100

⇒ (2400 × 6.25 × 0.2)/100

⇒ Rs. 30

**∴ Simple interest incurred on Rs. 2,400 from 20 March 2019 to 31 May 2019 at 6{1 over 4}% rate is Rs. 30.**
